summary: The proof establishes a support-independent strict gap in intrinsic rank three. The reflected-mass normalization agrees exactly with the supplied predecessor fact. The halfspace variance estimate and finite polar-halfspace cover force any sequence approaching 1/64 to concentrate on a complete full-rank high-mass support. The predecessor bounds then force an eight-point core with all eight parity classes, while log-affinity and midpoint completeness force any additional site to retain a fixed positive mass, contradicting that concentration. Boundary centers, lower-rank conditional supports, finite tilts, and the infimum quantifiers are all handled correctly.
